To Whom It May Concern

It is my pleasure to recommend Amaan Siddiqui, who studied Satellite Communication and Digital Signal Processing under me during his B.Tech at Netaji Subhas University of Technology.

As a student, Amaan is able to grasp quickly and accurately, even the most complex of concepts taught in class and takes his academic success very seriously. During the time I have interacted with him, Amaan displayed great sense of discipline and inquisitiveness for the subject. The key ability of Amaan that I would like to highlight is his punctuality in class. Amaan is a meritorious student and has always put forth a logical approach to solving problems. Amaan has been driven to come up with brainstroming questions and has good analytical thinking.

Furthermore, I would like to add that Amaan's passion extends beyond classroom.

I truly believe that Amaan would be a tremendous addition to the institution of his choice and his candidacy has my full support.

Yours sincerely,
